caption.text:
Gempa besar magnitudo 7,1 mengguncang Pulau Kyushu, Jepang, pada Selasa (28/7). Guncangan kuat itu sempat memicu peringatan tsunami.⁣
⁣
Gempa ini turut menyebabkan sejumlah bangunan ambruk, kebakaran, serta kerusakan pada jalan dan jembatan. Badan Meteorologi Jepang (JMA) sempat memperingatkan potensi gelombang tsunami hingga 1 meter. ⁣
⁣
Namun, kurang dari dua jam setelah gempa, peringatan tsunami resmi dicabut setelah tidak teramati adanya aktivitas tsunami di wilayah pesisir.⁣
⁣
Otoritas Jepang juga memastikan tidak ada anomali pada pembangkit listrik tenaga nuklir di wilayah terdampak. Sementara itu, pemerintah masih mendata jumlah korban dan tingkat kerusakan akibat gempa tersebut.⁣
⁣
#gempa #jepang #detiknews
caption.text_translation:
A massive 7.1 magnitude earthquake shook Kyushu Island, Japan, on Tuesday (28/7). The strong shake managed to trigger a tsunami warning.

The earthquake also caused a number of buildings to collapse, fires, and damage to roads and bridges. The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) managed to warn of the potential of a tsunami wave up to 1 meter.

However, less than two hours after the quake, the official tsunami warning was lifted after no tsunami activity was observed in the coastal areas.

Japanese authorities also confirmed there were no anomalies at nuclear power plants in the affected areas. Meanwhile, the government is still processing the number of casualties and the level of damage caused by the earthquake.

 #gempa #jepang #detiknews
